prompt.project_info: Create a high-saturation retro-modern disco-pop portrait of one approved adult woman against a solid pink wall with a metallic disco ball.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with sleek brunette high ponytail, rose-tinted transparent aviator sunglasses, pink high-leg spandex bodysuit with white piping, and red glossy high heels. She sits on a reversed glossy red chair in a poised over-the-shoulder fashion pose.
composition_elements: Vertical medium-full shot with centered silhouette.
Subject seated on a reversed glossy red chair, torso angled toward camera, legs arranged naturally.
Large multifaceted metallic silver disco ball held near the torso.
Solid bubblegum/fuchsia/hot-pink wall with sharp drop-off shadow.
Caustic square reflections from the disco ball appear on the subject and wall.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard left-side studio light, sharp defined shadows, specular highlights on bodysuit and disco ball, glossy high-contrast digital finish.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fashion photography, vertical medium-full framing, high saturation, realistic spandex and metal reflections, clean digital finish, no text or watermark.
